# Preface {.unnumbered #sec-preface}

| I wrote of Quirework, with its aid, this book.
| Confession, or a demonstration? Which,
| I can't decide. I know how that must look.
| It has no view on sentences. Its pitch:

| It keeps a list of what the book must bear,
| Then reads the chapters, flags what won't agree.
| It warned me several times. The faults were there.
| I fixed most faults it pointed out to me.

| If chapters clash, you've found a thing it missed.
| I'd like to hear, though less than you'd suppose.
| Each name is changed, and all that earned a twist
| Has been exaggerated in the prose.

| The rest is of a different book, and too
| Of what, instead of finishing, I'd do.
